<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/transfer-proposals:generate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Deterministic, explainable proposal generation over a caller-provided
coherent planning snapshot. Validation failures return RFC 7807
problem+json. Diagnostic boundary: production planning consumes local
read models via the simulation endpoint instead.
